page_title: ALM 1-3 RMA | Almeria v Real Madrid 19/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Alejandro Pozo (Almeria) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+4' A defender mistimes his tackle on the edge on the box and let's in Fran Garcia (Real Madrid). It's a decent effort but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
90+2' Lazaro joins the action as a substitute, replacing Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria).
90+1' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Sergio Arribas as he is replaced by Arnau Puigmal (Almeria).
90' 9 additional min. will be played.
90' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to substitute Vinicius Junior and he is replaced by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid).
90' Federico Valverde will be replaced by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid).
90' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
89' The current number of shots on goal is 8:8.
87' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
84' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
81' Substitution. Joselu (Real Madrid) replaces Jude Bellingham.
79' An attempted cross from Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) is cleared.
77' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
75' The referee blows for a cooling break.
73' 1 - 3 Goal! Jude Bellingham plays a short, square pass into the path of Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who bends a shot straight into the top left corner to make it 1:3. Fabulous goal!
72' Here comes a substitution. Toni Kroos is given a rest as he is replaced by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
72' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) replaces Rodrygo.
70' Vicente Moreno prepares a substitution. Lucas Robertone (Almeria) is replaced by Gonzalo Melero.
69' The game has come to an end for Marc Pubill. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alejandro Pozo (Almeria).
69' CHANCE! Daniel Carvajal finds Rodrygo (Real Madrid) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post!
64' Luis Suarez (Almeria) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Largie Ramazani trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ibrahima Kone (Almeria).
60' 1 - 2 Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) heads the ball low inside the right post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
59' Chumi (Almeria) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
59' Luis Suarez (Almeria) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
56' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

56' A nice lofted cross finds Largie Ramazani (Almeria) unmarked and he displays an excellent touch to control the ball. Largie Ramazani (Almeria) drills a low shot towards the middle of the net, but doesn't give the goalkeeper anything to worry about. An easy save.
55' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
53' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Sanchez has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
53' Almeria work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
50' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
48' Sergio Akieme (Almeria) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+8' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' The goal by Real Madrid is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to a foul.
45+6' Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez has indicated he is going to review the Real Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
45+5' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) unleashes a volley from just outside the box which goes inside the right post. What a shot that is!
45+3' Almeria failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
42' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
42' The corner is swung in but Real Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
42' The resulting set piece from Almeria is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Lucas Robertone (Almeria) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the right post.
39' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jose Sanchez no option but to blow his whistle.
38' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Almeria.
34' Iddrisu Baba Mohammed (Almeria) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Andriy Lunin was alert and made a comfortable save.
33' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
31' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
30' Real Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
28' Close! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post.
26' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

24' That didn't go as planned! Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Luis Maximiano, who easily kept it out.
23' Luis Suarez (Almeria) commits a rough foul. Jose Sanchez stops the game and makes a call. Real Madrid have a free kick from a promising distance.
22' Marc Pubill (Almeria) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
20' Referee Jose Sanchez points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes wild in celebration.
20' Wait! Referee Jose Sanchez has indicated he is going to review the Real Madrid goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
19' 1 - 1 Goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
17' Jose Sanchez blows for a foul after Chumi (Almeria) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
15' David Alaba (Real Madrid) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
15' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
13' The ball is cleared after Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

10' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Luis Maximiano makes a comfortable save.
8' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries his luck with a shot from long distance after receiving a good pass. His poorly placed effort flies miles wide of the right post.
7' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the bottom left corner is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
6' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
5' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

3' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Sergio Arribas (Almeria) makes it 1:0. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Lucas Robertone and planted his close-range header into the bottom right corner. Andriy Lunin was helpless.

3' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
2' Marc Pubill (Almeria) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Almeria will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Jose Sanchez.
